name: Bo kho
summary: Bò kho is the morning beef stew on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, and it is also on the shared list with Phạm Hồng Thái.
origin: A Da Nang breakfast on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning on the breakfast street.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in the morning. One account says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 account prints 06:00–12:00. It is also on the shared list with Phạm Hồng Thái.
seoTitle: Bo kho — morning on Huynh Thuc Khang
seoDescription: Bò kho is the morning beef stew on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng in Da Nang, and it is also listed with Phạm Hồng Thái.
